scenarios.title: Verify Insights View Navigation for Functional Tests
scenarios.description: Test the navigation to the Insights view for functional tests in Playwright
scenarios.testDescription: Verify that users can navigate to and access the Insights view specifically for functional tests using Playwright
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. User has access to the application
3. Functional tests are already configured in the system
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Launch the application
2. Navigate to the testing dashboard
3. Select or click on 'Functional Tests' section
4. Click on 'Insights' or 'Insights View' option
scenarios.expectedResult: The Insights view for Functional tests should be displayed, showing relevant metrics and data visualizations

scenarios.title: Verify Content of Functional Test Insights View
scenarios.description: Test that the Insights view for functional tests displays all required information
scenarios.testDescription: Ensure that the Insights view for functional tests contains all necessary elements and data similar to Unit, Integration, and API test insights
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. User has access to the Insights view for functional tests
3. There is existing functional test data to display
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Tests section
2. Open the Insights view
3. Verify presence of test execution metrics
4. Check for pass/fail statistics
5. Verify presence of execution time data
6. Check for trend visualizations
7. Verify presence of error categorization if applicable
scenarios.expectedResult: All required information should be displayed in the Insights view including statistics, charts, and performance metrics relevant to functional tests

scenarios.title: Verify Filtering Capabilities in Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Test the functionality of filters in the Functional test Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Ensure that users can filter the displayed functional test insights based on different criteria
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. User has access to the Insights view for functional tests
3. Multiple functional test results exist in the system
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Identify available filter options (e.g., date range, test status, test module)
3. Apply a filter for a specific time period
4. Apply a filter for test status (passed/failed)
5. Apply a filter for specific test modules or components
6. Clear all filters
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. The insights data should update correctly based on each filter applied
2. Multiple filters should work in combination
3. Clearing filters should restore the complete data view

scenarios.title: Test Consistency Between Functional Test Insights and Actual Results
scenarios.description: Verify that the data shown in Insights view matches actual functional test execution results
scenarios.testDescription: Ensure that the metrics and data shown in the Functional test Insights view accurately reflect the actual test execution results
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. A set of functional tests have been executed with known results
3. User has access to both raw test results and Insights view
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Run a set of functional tests with Playwright and note the results
2. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
3. Compare the following between raw results and Insights view:
   a. Number of tests passed/failed
   b. Execution times
   c. Error types and frequencies
   d. Coverage metrics if applicable
scenarios.expectedResult: All metrics and data in the Insights view should exactly match the actual test execution results with no discrepancies

scenarios.title: Verify Export Functionality of Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Test the ability to export Functional test insights data
scenarios.testDescription: Verify that users can export the Functional test insights data in various formats for external use
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. User has access to the Insights view for functional tests
3. Export functionality is implemented
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate export options/button
3. Select and export data in available formats (e.g., CSV, PDF, JSON)
4. Open the exported files
5. Compare exported data with what is shown in the UI
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. Export options should be available and functional
2. Exported files should be generated in the selected formats
3. Data in exported files should match what is displayed in the Insights view

scenarios.title: Test Historical Data Comparison in Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Verify the ability to compare current functional test results with historical data
scenarios.testDescription: Ensure that the Functional test Insights view allows for comparison of current test results with previous executions
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. Multiple runs of functional tests exist in the system
3. User has access to the Insights view
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate the historical comparison feature (e.g., trend graphs, comparison view)
3. Select specific time periods or test runs for comparison
4. Review comparative metrics for:
   a. Pass/fail ratios
   b. Execution time trends
   c. Most frequent failures
   d. Stability indicators
scenarios.expectedResult: The Insights view should display accurate comparative data between current and historical functional test executions, showing trends and changes over time

scenarios.title: Performance Test of Functional Test Insights View Loading
scenarios.description: Measure the performance and load time of the Functional Test Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Verify that the Functional Test Insights view loads within acceptable time limits, even with large amounts of test data
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. A large dataset of functional test results exists in the system
3. Performance measurement tools are available
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Clear browser cache if needed
2. Start performance monitoring tools
3. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
4. Record the time taken for the page to fully load
5. Record the time for interactive elements to become responsive
6. Repeat steps 3-5 multiple times to get average metrics
scenarios.expectedResult:
1. The Insights view should load within 3 seconds for typical data volumes
2. Interactive elements should be responsive within 1 second of page load
3. No significant performance degradation should occur with large datasets

scenarios.title: Cross-Browser Compatibility of Functional Test Insights
scenarios.description: Test the compatibility of the Functional Test Insights view across different browsers
scenarios.testDescription: Ensure that the Functional Test Insights view renders and functions correctly across all supported browsers
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright is configured for multi-browser testing
2. Test environment has access to multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
3. Functional test data exists in the system
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Launch the application in Chrome browser
2. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view and verify all elements render correctly
3. Repeat steps 1-2 in Firefox browser
4. Repeat steps 1-2 in Safari browser
5. Repeat steps 1-2 in Edge browser
6. Compare visual appearance and functionality across all browsers
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional Test Insights view should display consistently and function correctly across all supported browsers without any visual discrepancies or functional differences

scenarios.title: Accessibility Testing of Functional Test Insights View
scenarios.description: Verify accessibility compliance of the Functional Test Insights view
scenarios.testDescription: Ensure that the Functional Test Insights view complies with accessibility standards and is usable by people with disabilities
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up
2. Accessibility testing tools are configured (e.g., axe-core integration)
3. Access to the Functional Test Insights view
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test Insights view
2. Run automated accessibility tests using Playwright accessibility tools
3. Check for:
   a. Proper heading structure
   b. Sufficient color contrast
   c. Alt text for images and charts
   d. Keyboard navigation support
   e. ARIA attributes where appropriate
4. Test screen reader compatibility
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional Test Insights view should meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with no critical accessibility issues detected

scenarios.title: Responsiveness Test of Functional Test Insights View
scenarios.description: Test the responsiveness of the Functional Test Insights view on different screen sizes
scenarios.testDescription: Verify that the Functional Test Insights view adapts and remains usable across different viewport sizes and devices
scenarios.prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing environment is set up with device emulation capabilities
2. Access to the Functional Test Insights view
scenarios.stepsToPerform:
1. Open the Functional Test Insights view on a desktop viewport (e.g., 1920x1080)
2. Verify all elements are properly displayed and interactive
3. Resize to tablet viewport (e.g., 768x1024)
4. Check for appropriate layout adjustments and usability
5. Resize to mobile viewport (e.g., 375x667)
6. Verify all critical information remains accessible and functional
7. Test specific responsive behaviors like collapsible menus and charts
scenarios.expectedResult: The Functional Test Insights view should adjust appropriately to different screen sizes, maintaining usability and access to all critical information across devices
